claims.text: On the development cavity, the production and conservative final central charges agree within 3e-4 particles; this is a bounded convergence statement, not a universal accuracy certificate.
The development sidebranch has greater initial central charge with occupied localized eigenstates than in the otherwise identical continuum-only ablation.

With the same spin model and production policy, the 48-time-unit experiment takes at least as much measured runtime as the 12-time-unit experiment; the chosen safe finite boundary does not guarantee horizon-independent cost.
The production no-drive control changes no central density by more than 1e-10 over its supplied horizon.
